# Contributing

Small fixes are welcome from anyone.

- Human contributors may send a pull request for a typo without opening an issue first.
- For other changes, start by picking an existing issue or opening a new one.
- Contributors using an AI agent, coding bot, or other automation must restrict
  their pull requests to open issues labeled `triaged` and either
  `help wanted` or `good first issue`. The issue must not be assigned to another
  contributor or already have an open pull request.

## Developer Certificate of Origin

Add a `Signed-off-by` line to every commit (`git commit -s`).

Every commit must also be cryptographically signed so that GitHub shows it as
Verified. Signing is separate from the DCO sign-off; both are required.
